result.stdout:
docx2adoc — convert a Word document to AsciiDoc

Usage:
  docx2adoc <input.docx> [-o <output.adoc>] [options]

Options:
  -o, --output <path>      Output file. Defaults to stdout (no media is written).
      --media-dir <name>   Media directory name beside the output (default: media).
      --no-media           Do not write extracted images.
      --report             Print the fidelity report to stderr.
      --min-fidelity <n>   Exit with code 3 when fidelity is below n (0-100).
      --reject-revisions   Keep the original text of tracked changes, not the revised one.
      --comments           Import Word comments as paragraphs with the comment role.
      --no-admonitions     Do not detect NOTE:/TIP:/WARNING: paragraphs and callout boxes.
      --no-code-blocks     Do not detect monospaced paragraphs as listing blocks.
      --no-properties      Do not import core properties into the document header.
      --plain-formatting   Drop underline/strikethrough/caps instead of keeping them as roles.
      --keep-heading       Do not promote a leading top-level heading to the document title.
  -q, --quiet              Suppress the progress line on stderr.
  -h, --help               Show this help.

Exit codes: 0 success, 1 conversion error, 2 usage error, 3 fidelity below --min-fidelity.
